verdict.rationale: AFK is an autonomous business-ops workspace, so asking whether it can be run headlessly or from CI is a fair question. The evidence only describes in-app autopilot, task graphs and approval gates, with no CLI, API, or CI integration for invoking it programmatically. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404, and the bare 'GitHubCode' link does not document any headless mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
